title: continuous-batcher-scheduler-tuning-queueing-fairness-starvation-timeouts
author: Ayesha Khan
description: Motivation: the continuous batcher scheduler favored large low-priority streams under mixed load, causing starvation of short high-priority requests and elevated tail latency. This PR tunes the scheduler to improve queueing fairness, prevent starvation via aging, add per-request/batch timeouts and early-flush heuristics, and make batching KV-cache aware so we better leverage warmed KV keys. Changes include: introduce priority-aware queue slots with configurable slot_share per priority and an admission rule that reserves a percentage of batch capacity for high-priority requests; add request age tracking and dynamic priority boost (aging) when age > aging_threshold_ms; implement per-batch timeout heuristics that trigger early flush when head-of-queue wait > flush_delay_ms or when estimated batch formation time would violate latency SLOs; add KV-cache hints to prefer requests with warm keys when forming batches to maximize KV reuse; attach kernel-selection hints (target_seq_len, quantization_friendly) into scheduler decisions so the runtime picks optimized kernels; add observability (scheduler.queue_wait_seconds, scheduler.starved_count, scheduler.aging_boosts, batch.early_flush_count, kv_cache.hit_rate_by_priority); add unit tests and a perf canary (mixed-priority workload) with A/B comparisons. Backwards compatibility: defaults preserve previous behavior unless new config flags are set. Checklist: [x] design doc updated; [x] tests added; [x] perf canary results included; [x] docs and config examples updated. Impact: in canary runs this reduces p99 latency for high-priority short requests by ~18% under mixed load while maintaining overall throughput. Config knobs added: slot_share_by_priority (map), aging_threshold_ms, flush_delay_ms, kv_hint_enabled.

release_notes: Improved continuous batcher scheduler fairness and starvation prevention: new priority-aware slot allocation, aging boosts, early-flush timeouts, KV-cache-aware batching, and new observability metrics. Operators can tune slot_share_by_priority and aging_threshold_ms to adjust tradeoffs between throughput and tail latency.
